content.text:
**My recommendation: start with Teal for managing your job search; choose Jobscan if your main need is checking an existing résumé against specific job descriptions.** That’s a fit-based recommendation from their published features—not a claim that either produces more interviews. ([tealhq.com](https://www.tealhq.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))

| | **Jobscan** | **Teal** |
|---|---|---|
| **Best fit** | Focused résumé matching and ATS-oriented feedback | Building tailored résumés and organizing applications |
| **Résumé tailoring** | Upload your résumé and a job description for match insights; premium adds AI optimization | Build résumé versions with keyword matching, analysis, and AI writing |
| **Application tracking** | Includes a job tracker | Unlimited free tracking, with saved jobs, notes, and application statuses |
| **Free version** | Limited résumé scans and premium insights | Unlimited résumés and job tracking; limited keyword insights and AI credits |
| **Paid pricing, USD** | $49.95/month or $89.95 every three months | $13 every seven days, $29 every 30 days, or $79 every 90 days |

Sources: Jobscan’s published comparison and Teal’s pricing and tracker pages. ([jobscan.co](https://www.jobscan.co/blog/jobscan-vs-teal/?utm_source=openai))

### Which I’d choose

- **Already have a résumé you like, but want targeted feedback? Jobscan.** Its upload-and-compare workflow is a good fit for that specific task. ([jobscan.co](https://www.jobscan.co/blog/jobscan-vs-teal/?utm_source=openai))
- **Need to create several résumé versions and keep applications organized? Teal.** Its free plan already covers unlimited résumés and tracking. ([tealhq.com](https://www.tealhq.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))
- **Want the lower-cost paid option? Teal+.** Its 30-day plan is substantially cheaper than Jobscan’s monthly plan; the quarterly price difference is smaller. ([tealhq.com](https://www.tealhq.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))

**My practical approach:** try Teal’s free plan and Jobscan’s limited free scans before subscribing. Pay only if the additional feedback or workflow saves you meaningful time. I wouldn’t pay for both initially.

Are you mainly looking for **ATS feedback, résumé writing, or application tracking**?
